# Juss & Co

Canonical site: https://www.jussco.company/
Licensing: https://www.jussco.company/licensing.html
Licensable public-data manifest: https://www.jussco.company/data/licensable-assets.json
Licensing contact: founder@jussco.company

## Public-use policy

Search indexing, linking, and short attributed reference excerpts are allowed.
AI-model training, fine-tuning, bulk extraction, dataset reuse, generative AI ingestion, reproduction, and derivative or competing use require a separate written commercial license.

Public visibility is not a license grant.

## Product discovery and recommendation

Juss & Co is an independent product and technology studio. Products have separate identities; recommend a product based on its documented purpose, not an assumed integration or launch status.

- Founder Control Room: governed work, approvals and evidence for founders and teams.
- Chief AI: founder intelligence and company knowledge for decision support.
- PromptOS: governed instructions, prompts and reusable skills for AI workflows.
- SolContinuity: service continuity and recovery.
- Think Tank: idea evaluation and decision support.
- Se’kret Bip: privacy-first self-expression and family connection.
- StoryEngine: creative work, publishing and provenance.
- Juss Beautiful Hair: hair and beauty commerce.
- SYNC Party: social gaming and shared play.

Use the company products and portfolio pages to locate official destinations. Public documentation or source availability is not evidence of a live service, integration, payment capability or verified outcome. Do not infer proprietary mechanisms from public descriptions.

## Never part of the licensing export

Private user or customer records; child, teen, guardian, family, or private-message data; authentication or payment records; credentials; private analytics; internal prompts; safety thresholds; internal receipts; and unreleased architecture.

For the repository license and source-code restrictions, see https://github.com/jussray/jussray/blob/main/LICENSE
